response.sql: WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`U-PRO`) <> '' AND `U-PRO` <> '-'), per AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM elig) GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM per GROUP BY SEX
